source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 23 April 1927, p. 8 ("Magherafelt Rural: nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 23 Apr 1927 p8 'Magherafelt Rural', read in the block image (BNL19270423.2.170 areas 5-6): 'There will not be any contests, and there will be five new members on the Council.'

note: Triennial election of Magherafelt rural district (26 divisions, one member each). Nominations were received by J. A. Higgins on 22 April 1927; there were no contests and five new members (Belfast News-Letter, 23 April 1927, p. 8). Polled Friday 27 May 1927: 'Polling took place yesterday in the Bellarena division of county Londonderry, the only division in the county where there was a contest' for the county council (Londonderry Sentinel, Saturday 28 May 1927, p. 8), and the Limavady rural contest in Straw 'took place on Friday' (Derry Journal, 30 May 1927, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
